paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage achieved over rounds of conversation with different feedback types indicated. The x-axis is labeled "Round of Conversation," using a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with each round represented at regular intervals of one unit. The y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 5 units. Two lines represent different feedback types. The first line, in yellow with circle markers and a solid style, represents the "Binary" feedback type, showing a steady increase starting at 10% accuracy at round 1 and reaching 24% at round 5. The second line, in blue with square markers and a solid style, represents the "Detailed" feedback type, starting at the same 10% accuracy in round 1 but rising to 27% by round 5, with notable increases particularly visible between each round. A legend is placed at the top left corner of the plot.
